'''July 2000 Springfield tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local (unsanctioned) held in Springfield, Illinois on 29 July 2000. It is known from David Marincic's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1101">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-07-normal-il-8-3-00d1101/ normal-il-8-3-00], DeckTech (David "Wedge659" Marincic, 7 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-07-normal-il-8-3-00d1101/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Springfield, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 4
